segments.text: Hey everyone! Batch 2 mein international air, sea aur road TAC khingge.
Ye central government civilian tour aur training par focus karta hai.
Railway aur armed forces ki alag instructions chek karen.
Example, foreign tour mein domestic klas ko copy nahi karenge.
Har example, hypothetical hai, sanction aur latest order chek karen.
International travel mein level 17 aur upar first klas hai.
Level 14 se 16 business ya club klas hai.
Level 13 aur niche ekonomi klas hai.
Level 13 eku level 13 ke barabar chek karenge.
Example, level 13A mein ekonomi, level 14 mein business.
Lekin entitlement, booking aur sanction, teen alag cheks hai.
Government paise de rahi ho, to ticket 3 authorized agents se lein.
Ye hai Balmer Lorry, Ashok Travels aur IRCTC.
Private airline bhi allowed hai, class aur sanction alak cheks hai.
Chozen 3-hour slot mein cheepest eligible fare bighin.
Non-stop preferabli lein, 10% price band ki rule check karein.
Example, groob ke ek tour ke li, ek hi selected agent use ho ga.
21 days pehle booking karna encouraged hai.
Tour booking 72 hours se kum pehle ho, justification de.
Cancellation 24 hours se kum pehle ho, alag reason de.
Example, 48 hours pehle booking per self declaration lagi ga.
Journey ke baat 72 hours mein completion certificate de,
unauthorized booking per competent relaxation chekk karein.
Foreign visit ke liye competent approval aur budget pehle chek karen, jaha screening committee
aur prime minister approval chahiye proposal 15 days pehle bhejhe aur 5 days se late nahi.
Example, secretary ka qualifying proposal time pehjna hoga. Training aur kuch delegations
ke exceptions bhi chek karen. Kuch international bodies ya agreements me sponsor terms apply
ho sakte hai. Dono sets ki allowances automatic jodna sahi nahi hai. Example, sponsor ne
flight peh ki toh wahi fair dubara kleem na karen. Visit approval, hospitality aur baaki
expenses alak chek hoonge.
Latest MEA order jo hume mila September 2023 ka hai. India se foreign tour par pehle 14 days
full admissible rate, next 14 days 75%, phir 60%. Example, mahan li full rate $100 hai. Qualifying
day 15 pr 75 dollars banega. Partial day aur baki adjustments alag verify karein.
Up overseas posted officers ki specified tours ka alag schedule. Pehle 7 days full,
agli 70-75%. Uski baat 50% of the full admissible rate. Example, $100 bees per day
8-75, day 15-50 dollars, baki applicable adjustments se pehle. India aur overseas schedules ko mix
mat karein.
Foreign hotel ke liye approved panel aur actual rental check karen.
Room rental mein service charges aur taxes bhi order mein hai.
Non-panel city mein capital city ka relevant lowest rate check ho ga.
Non-representational training mein hotel entitlement ek step lower hai.
Example, seminar ke liye normal panel ki lower step confirm karen.
Domestic hotel limit ko foreign hotel par copy na karen.
Hotel charge mein breakfast ho to daily allowance 10% kump.
Example, 100 dollars par sirf yeh reduction lagi to 90.
State guest aur sari meals free ho to 25% rate.
Tips ke liye daily allowance ke upar extra reimbursement nahi.
Ek se zyada deductions ho to office se method confirm karen.
Foreign daily allowance mein, official duty transport included nahi hai. Necessary aur reasonable
conveyance alak se chek ho sakta hai. Sanction mein ish kharch ke liye specific funds hona
bhi zaroori hai. Example, official meeting ka eligible taxi bill separately dekhay. Sight
seeing ka taxi apne aap official duty claim nahi bantha.
Currency conversion ke liye official MEA rate chek karein. Latest MEA order jo hume mila
september 2023 ka hai. Level 10 aur upar annexure ka full prescribed rate chek karein. Level
2 se 9 mein copies ki percentage reading conflict karti hai. Example, level 7 ka calculation
legible official copy se verify karein. Later amendment aur departmental adoption bhi
chek karein.
Ab see ya river steamer ka standard table. Level 9 aur upar highest, level 3 aur niche lowest
class. Level 6 se 8 mein 2 classes hon to lower class. Level 4 aur 5 mein 2, 3 ya 4 classes
alag dekhhen. Example, teen classes mein level 5 ke liye middle ya second. Level 6 se 8 ke
teen class case mein office se puhchhen. Mainland aur island ke beach qualifying SCI ship ka
alag table. Level 9 aur upar deluxe 6 se 8 first ya A cabin. Level 4 aur 5 second ya B cabin.
3 aur niche bunk. Example, eligible level 7 ka SCI ship par A cabin chekhoga. Har private
feri par ye special table automatikli nahi lagain.
Jaha specific transport rates prescribed hai, pay level dekhain. Level 14 aur upar, public
AC bus bhi lehsakte hai. AC taxi actually use ho, to prescribed AC taxi rate dekhain. Listed
modes par prescribed auto rate wala option bhi hai. Example, level 14 AC taxi use kare
to relevant rate check hoga. Level 6 to 13 ke liye AC taxi permissible nehi hai. Level
4 aur 5 ke liye public bus, likin AC bus nehi. Level 3 aur niche ordinary public bus wali
ro hai. Listed auto ya own scooter jaisi modes par auto rate dekhain. Example, level 3 ordinary
bus ka actual fare check kareega. Us lower ro mein own car expressly listed nehi hai. Rout,
sanction aur proof ke baaki checks bhi zaruri hai.
State aur neighbouring state dono ki specific rate na ho, fallback dikhe.
2017 base, onkarya taxi ke liye 24 rupees per kilometre, auto ya on scooter ke liye 12 rupees
per kilometre. Peheli 25% increase se 30 aur 15 bante hai. Example, eligible auto me 20
kilometres ka result 300. Ye result sanction, actual journey aur mode eligibility ki subject
hai. Jaha reel nahi hai, eligible EC2 aur uparwalon ke liye EC bus, baaki ke liye deluxe ya ordinary
bus ka rule dikhe. Reel connected route peh public transport ka fare train class se capped
hai. Example, bus 400, entitled train 500. Is public fare example me cap cross nahi hua.
Private vehicle claims peh rahi clause automatic mat lagain.
Road per employee ki journey aur transfer effects alak components hai. Level 6 aur upper effects
ka base Rs. 50 per kilometre tha. Pehli increase ke baat, calculation 62.50 hai. Example, 50
kilometres ka ceiling calculation dekhe. Result hai, Rs. 3125. Actual transport, receipt
aur applicable exception alak chek karen. Ye calculated ceiling apnea payment nahi hai.
Government Boats aur remote scientific fieldwork ka special rule hai. Qualifying case mein
daily allowance food rate ke baarabar hosakta hai. Head ya controlling officer ki approval
aur conditions chek karen. Example, approved survey ka government boat journey alag assess
hoga. Foot mileage aur uski index trade bhi alak chek hai. Detailed sources aur pending
verification companion guide mein hai.
